_note: The appointed times, passage by passage (biblecore/calendar.py). Policy: a human adds a feast; the validator checks it. Book sessions fill it from Lev 23, Num 28-29 and Deut 16, then core is released and vendored. Seeded 2026-11-13 from Lev 23, Num 28-29 and Deut 16 (Wave 2), in Leviticus' decided terms.

feasts.title: Daily offering
feasts.note: Num 28–29 counts everything else as 'in addition to' this offering. Only Num 28 lists it; Lev 23 and Deut 16 do not.

passages.date: every day, one lamb in the morning and one at twilight
requires: Two male lambs a year old, without defect, each day as a regular going up offering, one in the morning and one at twilight.
Gift offering with each lamb: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter hin of beaten oil.
Drink offering with each lamb: a quarter hin of strong drink, poured out in the holy place to Yahweh.
Brought at its appointed time, a fire offering of soothing aroma to Yahweh; the one ordained at Mount Sinai.
Six days work is done; the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy gathering.
No work of any kind; a Sabbath to Yahweh in all your dwellings.
Two male lambs a year old, without defect, with a gift offering of two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil, and its drink offering.
This is each Sabbath's going up offering, in addition to the regular going up offering and its drink offering.

feasts.title: New moon
feasts.note: Only Num 28 gives the new moon an offering; Lev 23 and Deut 16 do not list it.

requires: Going up offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the ram, one tenth for each lamb.
Drink offering: half a hin of wine for each bull, a third of a hin for the ram, a quarter of a hin for each lamb.
One male goat as a sin offering to Yahweh, in addition to the regular going up offering with its gift offering and drink offering.
This is the going up offering of each new moon through the months of the year.

feasts.title: Passover
feasts.note: Deut 16:1 gives only the month of Abib, not the day.

passages.date: first month, fourteenth day, at twilight
requires: Named as Yahweh's Passover; no offering or other requirement is given in this verse.
Named as Yahweh's Passover; no offering is listed for it here (the offerings begin on the fifteenth).

passages.date: in the month of Abib, when Yahweh brought you out of Egypt by night
requires: Keep the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to Yahweh your God.
Sacrifice the Passover, of the flock and the herd, at the place Yahweh chooses to make his name dwell.
Not to be sacrificed within any of your gates, but only at the place Yahweh chooses.
Sacrifice it there at evening, at sunset, at the season you came out of Egypt; roast and eat it there.
In the morning return to your tents.

feasts.title: Unleavened Bread
feasts.note: Deut 16:3–4 gives seven days and 16:8 gives six; the table lists each as the verse has it. Deut 16:16–17 covers all three pilgrimage festivals and is repeated under Weeks and Shelters.

passages.date: first month, fifteenth day, for seven days
requires: Eat unleavened bread seven days.
First day: a holy gathering; no regular work.
Seven days: a fire offering to Yahweh.
Seventh day: a holy gathering; no regular work.

passages.date: first month, fifteenth day, for seven days
requires: Eat unleavened bread seven days; first day a holy gathering, no regular work.
Each of the seven days: a going up offering to Yahweh of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the ram, one tenth for each lamb.
Each day one male goat as a sin offering to cover for you, in addition to the morning's regular going up offering.
Seventh day: a holy gathering; no regular work.
Eat no leavened bread with the Passover; eat unleavened bread seven days, the bread of affliction, to remember the day you came out of Egypt.
No yeast seen in all your borders seven days.
None of the meat sacrificed on the first day at evening is left until morning.

passages.date: six days, then the seventh day
requires: Eat unleavened bread six days.
Seventh day: a closing gathering to Yahweh your God; no work.
All your males appear before Yahweh your God three times a year at the place he chooses: at the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Shelters.
None appears empty; each gives as able, by the blessing Yahweh has given.

feasts.title: First sheaf
feasts.note: Num 28–29 and Deut 16 have no row for it; Deut 16:9 starts the count of weeks when the sickle is first put to the standing grain.

passages.date: the day after the Sabbath, once the harvest is reaped
requires: After entering the land and reaping its harvest, bring the sheaf of the first of your harvest to the priest, who waves it before Yahweh the day after the Sabbath.
On that day, a male lamb a year old, without defect, as a going up offering to Yahweh.
Gift offering of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, a fire offering of soothing aroma; drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.
No bread, roasted grain or fresh grain is eaten until that day; a statute forever.

passages.date: fifty days after the seventh Sabbath
requires: Count seven full Sabbaths from the day after the Sabbath on which the sheaf was brought; fifty days to the day after the seventh Sabbath, then a new gift offering to Yahweh.
Bring from your dwellings two loaves for waving: two tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with yeast, firstfruits to Yahweh.
With the bread: seven male lambs a year old without defect, one young bull and two rams as a going up offering, with their gift and drink offerings.
One male goat as a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old as a well-being offering sacrifice; the priest waves them with the bread.
That same day, a holy gathering; no regular work; a statute forever.

passages.date: the day of the firstfruits, at your Weeks
requires: On the day of the firstfruits, when you offer a new gift offering to Yahweh at your Weeks, a holy gathering; no regular work.
Going up offering of soothing aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old.
Gift offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the ram, one tenth for each lamb.
One male goat to cover for you, in addition to the regular going up offering and its gift offering; all without defect, with their drink offerings.

passages.date: seven weeks from the first sickle in the standing grain
requires: Count seven weeks, beginning when the sickle is first put to the standing grain.
Keep the Festival of Weeks to Yahweh with a freewill gift from your hand, given as Yahweh blesses you.
Rejoice before Yahweh at the place he chooses, with your son, daughter, servants, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.
Remember that you were a slave in Egypt.
All your males appear before Yahweh your God three times a year at the place he chooses: at the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Shelters.
None appears empty; each gives as able, by the blessing Yahweh has given.
A solemn rest, a remembrance of shouting, a holy gathering.
No regular work; a fire offering to Yahweh.
A holy gathering; no regular work; it is a day of shouting for you.
Going up offering of soothing aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram, one tenth for each lamb.
One male goat as a sin offering to cover for you.
All in addition to the new moon's going up offering and gift offering, and the regular going up offering and gift offering, with their drink offerings.

feasts.title: Day of Coverings
feasts.note: Lev 16 gives the rite itself; Lev 23 and Num 29 give the day's date and requirements. Deut 16 has no row.

passages.date: seventh month, tenth day; from evening to evening, beginning at evening of the ninth
requires: A holy gathering; afflict yourselves; a fire offering to Yahweh.
No work of any kind that day, for it is a Day of Coverings, to cover for you before Yahweh your God.
Whoever does not afflict himself that day is cut off from his people; whoever does any work, Yahweh will destroy from among his people.
A Sabbath of solemn rest; a statute forever.
A holy gathering; afflict yourselves; no work.
Going up offering of soothing aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram, one tenth for each lamb.
One male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the Day of Coverings' sin offering and the regular going up offering with its gift offering and drink offerings.

feasts.title: Festival of Shelters
feasts.note: Num 29 gives one passage per day, the bulls falling from thirteen to seven. The eighth day is its own feast. Deut 16:16–17 is repeated from Unleavened Bread and Weeks.

passages.date: seventh month, fifteenth day, for seven days
requires: First day: a holy gathering; no regular work.
Seven days: a fire offering to Yahweh.

passages.date: seventh month, fifteenth day, after the produce is gathered in; seven days
requires: Keep the festival to Yahweh seven days, when the produce of the land is gathered in; first day a solemn rest, eighth day a solemn rest.
On the first day take the fruit of majestic trees, palm branches, boughs of leafy trees and willows of the brook, and rejoice before Yahweh your God seven days.
A statute forever, kept in the seventh month.
Dwell in shelters seven days (all native-born in Israel), so your generations know Yahweh made Israel dwell in shelters when he brought them out of Egypt.
A holy gathering; no regular work; keep a festival to Yahweh seven days.
Going up offering of soothing aroma to Yahweh: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for each bull, two tenths for each ram, one tenth for each lamb.
Each day, one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular going up offering with its gift offering and drink offering.
Going up offering: twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift and drink offerings for the bulls, rams and lambs, by their number, as the ordinance says.
Each day, one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular going up offering with its gift offering and drink offering.
Going up offering: eleven young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift and drink offerings for the bulls, rams and lambs, by their number, as the ordinance says.
Each day, one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular going up offering with its gift offering and drink offering.
Going up offering: ten young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift and drink offerings for the bulls, rams and lambs, by their number, as the ordinance says.
Each day, one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular going up offering with its gift offering and drink offering.
Going up offering: nine young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift and drink offerings for the bulls, rams and lambs, by their number, as the ordinance says.
Each day, one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular going up offering with its gift offering and drink offering.
Going up offering: eight young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift and drink offerings for the bulls, rams and lambs, by their number, as the ordinance says.
Each day, one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular going up offering with its gift offering and drink offering.
Going up offering: seven young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift and drink offerings for the bulls, rams and lambs, by their number, as the ordinance says.
Each day, one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular going up offering with its gift offering and drink offering.

passages.date: seven days, after the threshing floor and winepress
requires: Keep the Festival of Shelters seven days, after you gather in from your threshing floor and winepress.
Rejoice in your festival, with your son, daughter, servants, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.
Keep the festival to Yahweh at the place he chooses, because he blesses all your increase; be altogether joyful.
All your males appear before Yahweh your God three times a year at the place he chooses: at the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks and the Festival of Shelters.
None appears empty; each gives as able, by the blessing Yahweh has given.
A holy gathering; a fire offering to Yahweh; a closing gathering; no regular work.
A closing gathering; no regular work.
Going up offering of soothing aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.
Gift and drink offerings for the bull, ram and lambs, by their number, as the ordinance says.
One male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular going up offering with its gift offering and drink offering.
